description: Before the fix, ci_guard read the `HARNESS-UPDATE-APPROVED` marker from the pull request TITLE on PR-like events (BC-032), and a title approved the pull request rather than a commit: a reviewer approved head A, the author force-pushed head B carrying a brand-new protected-zone change, the gate re-ran, the unchanged title still carried the marker, and the merge was allowed. Post-fix, on PR-like events the title marker must be BOUND to the head under review (`HARNESS-UPDATE-APPROVED@<sha>`, a 7-to-40-hex prefix of env.PR_HEAD_SHA, which the deployed workflow forwards from github.event.pull_request.head.sha). A bare marker on a pull request is refused; a title bound to the head a reviewer saw is refused once a further protected commit moves the head; a pull-request run without a commit-shaped PR_HEAD_SHA fails closed. Push events still read the HEAD commit message.
fix_module: tools/cc/ci_guard.py::_approval_marker_present (the title marker names the head under review; the workflow forwards PR_HEAD_SHA)
